messages:
satoshi: Heads-up — running solstice-v1 (quant=q4_k) onboarding smoke on staging. Quick eval shows odd locale-specific detokenize/translation diffs for zh-HK and he/ar. posting logs and samples.

elaine: repro steps? any sample diffs we can paste here?

satoshi: command I ran:
```
eval/run_eval.py --model solstice-v1 --quant q4_k --suites multilang:simple_translation --locales zh-HK,zh-CN,he,ar --out /tmp/solstice_q4_smoke.jsonl
```

satoshi: short sample diffs (input -> gold -> solstice-q4):
- input: "將於 3/5 (五) 開始"
  gold: "Starts on 3/5 (Fri)"
  solstice-q4: "Starts on 3/5 ）Fri("  <-- parentheses order flipped for zh-HK

michael: whoa :eyes: that's a delimiter mirroring issue. Could be bidi interaction leaking into detokenize.

yun: also seeing hebrew example:
- input: "(תאריך) 12/4"
  gold: "(Date) 12/4"
  solstice-q4: "(תאריך] 12/4"  <-- closing bracket changed to ']' and orientation wrong

elaine: can you paste the tokenizer tokens for those inputs? Need to check token boundaries vs detok normalization.

satoshi: tokens we see locally:
```
# zh input tokens: ["將", "於", " ", "3", "/", "5", " ", "(", "五", ")", " ", "開始"]
# solstice-q4 tokens (post-inference detok): ["將", "於", " ", "3", "/", "5", " ", "）", "五", "（", " ", "開始"]
```
(note: parentheses glyphs swapped and unicode mirrored glyphs present)

satoshi: bisected perf: roughly 0.2 BLEU drop zh-HK, ~0.7 BLEU drop he/ar vs baseline q8. Not catastrophic but consistent across ~500 samples.

L10n-bot: /report locale_anomaly model=solstice-v1 quant=q4_k suites=multilang:simple_translation delta_bleu_zhHK=-0.21 delta_bleu_he=-0.68 samples=512

elaine: OK assign to kernel + tokenizer teams. @michael @yun can you triage? Add to regression board and mark for fast rollback if it worsens.

michael: plan: run q8 -> q4_k bisect focusing on detok pipeline. If tokenstream is identical pre-detok, looks like detok or postprocessing normalization. If tokens differ, kernel tokenmap issue. Will run bisect now.

yun: quick grep hint I used: `grep -n "normalize|mirr" runtime/kernels -R` — saw a recently added normalize table in kernels/utf_fold.c but havent confirmed link.

satoshi: short-term mitigation: route zh and he requests to q8 variant via routing policy. Config snippet:
```json
{"routing":{"locale_overrides":{"zh-HK":{"model_variant":"solstice-v1-q8"},"he":{"model_variant":"solstice-v1-q8"}}}
```

michael: creating a bisect PR and running smoke harness. will report back in ~45m. tagging this thread solstice-onboard-quant-locale.

Triage-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342 solstice-quant-locale-regress (priority=P2)

elaine: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

satoshi: adding note — examples attached to the incident include exact token dumps, detok logs, and the inference kernel commit range. Will follow up with a minimal repro for the tokenizer team.

michael: update: bisect points to kernel commit 0f3b9 -> 1a2c4 where a small mapping change to the unicode table got in. Suspect q4_k kernel pack used an alternate unicode normalization path. continuing.

yun: if we need a quick patch: revert that mapping in the q4_k build; otherwise fallback routing.

elaine: good. keep thread updated. If anyone sees translation regressions in other locales, ping asap.
